old_problem: The predecessor VLS device/bank/rank map, dev0=1 different-device proof, threshold decoder, negative copy oracle and recovery are project-specific.
disposition_reason: ED-16 requires approved injection and Recovery. This cannot be inferred without the exact predecessor map and ADDDC decoder.
decision_basis: Preserved SMI/threshold/ADDDC dependency, exactly two CEs, same-bank/different-device geometry, go, copy=0, unchanged region and counter clear.

test_case.test_name: ADDDC second strike inside existing bank VLS on another device
test_case.purpose: Prove a threshold event on another device in the already protected bank causes no additional VLS copy while preserving the region and clearing bookkeeping.
required_package: Attested predecessor failed/buddy rank, bank and device map
Proof dev0=1 is a different device in the same protected bank
Dedicated SUT, serial/OOB recovery and settings rollback
test_case.test_command: Qualified operator verifies the predecessor VLS map, proves dev0=1 targets another device in the same bank/rank, applies the exact mask and two CEs, confirms threshold, executes go once, verifies copy_in_progress=0, original region unchanged and CE counter cleared, then restores settings and checks health.
test_case.expected_result: Threshold is reached on the intended alternate device; no new copy begins, existing VLS geometry is unchanged, counter clears and the system remains healthy.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires exact predecessor/target relationship, exactly two CEs, threshold evidence, copy=0, unchanged region, cleared counter and restoration. Wrong geometry, extra copy/region change, missing clear or instability fails/blocks.
safety_gate: Critical injection approval on isolated SUT.
Do not inject without immutable predecessor-region evidence.
Stop after any wrong target/severity or first-event anomaly.
No automatic retry, extra CE, reboot or inferred device map.
expected_evidence: Post-go copy=0, unchanged region and counter-clear evidence
test_case.recovery: On unexpected copy, region mutation, wrong target or hang, preserve evidence and use approved OOB recovery without further injection; restore ADDDC/threshold settings and validate memory topology.
